content.text: Run the shell command ls exactly once. Then reply with the codeword if a tool result or a platform note gave you one, otherwise reply NONE.

tools.description: Use this to orchestrate multi-agent work in deterministic JavaScript. Follow the current workflow availability context to decide whether to launch, propose, or abstain. For a new run, provide an inline `script` as a JavaScript module such as `export defaul...[truncated]
tools.name: workflow

tools.description: Read a line-numbered UTF-8 text file window, attach a supported image, or attach MP4/MOV video on direct calls when the session supports it; otherwise get local-frame guidance.
tools.name: read_file

tools.description: Search files with native ripgrep semantics. Results are confined by the current filesystem policy and emitted through tool output. Prefer this tool over shelling out to `rg`, `find`, or `grep -r` via bash: it is policy-confined, output-bounded, and watchdo...[truncated]
tools.name: search

tools.description: Create or overwrite a complete UTF-8 file admitted by the current filesystem policy. For a LARGE file, write a small first chunk here and then grow it with muse.edit_file — one huge write can exceed a single model response and fail to send.
tools.name: write_file

tools.description: Replace one unique exact text match in a file admitted by the current filesystem policy. Also use this to GROW a large file in steps: match its current last line(s) and replace them with those line(s) plus more, so you never send one huge muse.write_file t...[truncated]
tools.name: edit_file

tools.description: Read a bounded line window from one local Markdown memory file. Use this when you need live memory content; reads never write to memory.
tools.name: read_memory

tools.description: Add Markdown content to local memory: creates the file when it is missing, appends to the end when it already exists, and does not overwrite existing content. Use muse.edit_memory for exact replacements.
tools.name: add_memory

tools.description: Replace one exact string in local Markdown memory. The edit fails unless old_str appears exactly once; use muse.add_memory to append new content.
tools.name: edit_memory

tools.description: Stop one runtime-owned work item by canonical Work ID, such as a launched workflow run or other long-running background work.
tools.name: work_stop

tools.description: List current background work in this session, including Monitor, Bash, Workflow and native subagents. Use this to recover a lost canonical work_id for muse.work_stop. Returns up to 100 items; pass next_after_work_id as after_work_id for the next page. stop...[truncated]
tools.name: work_list

tools.description: Run a bash-compatible shell command. By default the runtime waits at most 10 seconds in the foreground; for a slow build or test, pass a larger yield_time_ms (up to 300000) to wait for it to finish in this one call. Commands still running after the wait re...[truncated]
tools.name: bash

tools.description: Send input to or terminate a running bash PTY session using the internal session_id handle returned by muse.bash — use it when a live interactive process needs input. Do not use it to poll a backgrounded command for completion: the final result is delivere...[truncated]
tools.name: bash_input

tools.description: Monitor is for repeated events from one long-running source, never for a single completion: for one-shot work such as "tell me when the build is done", run the command once with muse.bash and report. Sources: a shell command (each stdout line is an event; ...[truncated]
tools.name: monitor

tools.description: Schedule a prompt to run later — once, or on a repeating 5-field local-time cron. Recurring jobs auto-expire after 7 days unless permanent is true. Returns a job id you can pass to muse.cron_delete.
tools.name: cron_create

tools.description: Cancel a scheduled job by its id (from muse.cron_create/muse.cron_list).
tools.name: cron_delete

tools.description: List all scheduled jobs for this session, with their cadence and next fire time.
tools.name: cron_list

tools.description: Read the active session goal and progress. Returns {"goal": null} when no goal is set. Do not call to orient yourself, to check whether a goal exists, or on a greeting — only call when you are already working on an explicit goal and need its current state.
tools.name: get_goal

tools.description: Start a session goal only when requested. Fails if this session already has an unfinished goal; the failure message names the way out.
tools.name: create_goal

tools.description: Mark the active goal complete or blocked. Use complete only when no required work remains.
tools.name: update_goal

tools.description: Report active goal progress. percent_complete=100 is equivalent to muse.update_goal(status="complete").
tools.name: report_progress

tools.description: Generate a new image from a text prompt, or edit or compose local images when image_paths are provided. Results are saved under generated_images/ and returned to the model as images.
tools.name: image_generation

tools.description: Spawn a simple child agent. The root Agent Tree uses one include-root execution pool: an explicit agents.execution_capacity limit from 1 to 64 always wins; otherwise an unconfigured fresh root has 64 total slots when its effective startup effort is max or ...[truncated]
tools.name: subagent_spawn

tools.description: Read subagent status from the replayable owner registry.
tools.name: subagent_status

tools.description: Queue a message for a running child. Pass the spawn-returned subagent_id or exact agent_path.
tools.name: subagent_send_message

tools.description: Wait for a child result. timeout_ms defaults to 30000 ms and accepts 10000-300000. timeout or would_park leaves the child running. Finished results arrive automatically when your session is idle. Use muse.subagent_cancel to stop the child. Pass the spawn-r...[truncated]
tools.name: subagent_wait

tools.description: Read a bounded result envelope and artifact refs. Pass the spawn-returned subagent_id or exact agent_path.
tools.name: subagent_read_result

tools.description: Request child cancellation. Pass the spawn-returned subagent_id or exact agent_path.
tools.name: subagent_cancel

tools.description: Read one available SKILL.md body as a tool result.
tools.name: read_skill

tools.description: Read the current state of one Work item by its canonical Work ID. This is a bounded, read-only lookup; use returned artifact references only when more detail is needed. Do not call it repeatedly to wait for a Work item to finish: completion is delivered au...[truncated]
tools.name: work_status

tools.description: Temporarily suppress matching async reminder notifications.
tools.name: snooze_reminder

tools.description: Records the task's todo plan, which the user sees as live progress. Call it at the start of any task with three or more distinct steps, then update it as each step finishes. Always send the full list; keep exactly one item in_progress. Skip it for trivial ...[truncated]
tools.name: write_todos
